title: spec(ui): the view display page size defaults to 50 — `PaginationConfigSchema.pageSize` `.default(25)` → `.default(50)` (maintainer ruling on objectui#9853)
body:
Filing gate ③: a ruled task. Director seat, summon #29 (`session_01EcrTi7s5oDYPHS4Pi7h31d`), executing objectui#9853 batch #223 item 4. Maintainer verbatim: 「9853 默认页大小改为50」. ⛔ Not a claim. Routing and grading are triage's.

## What
The maintainer set the platform's default **display page size** to **50**. It is declared in one place, `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` `PaginationConfigSchema`: `pageSize: z.number().int().positive().default(25)`. The consumer (objectui) reads the spec default rather than keeping its own number (objectui#9853 ruling C′, item 1). So the change lands **here first**: protocol first, ⛔ never a hardcoded 50 in the renderer.

## Deliverable
- `.default(25)` → `.default(50)`, with its describe unchanged in meaning.
- A sweep of every text that states the display default as 25, all regenerated or edited in the same PR: pins, generated reference pages, docs and examples. Count by declaration, not by grep mentions.
- The positive-integer refusal is unchanged; the `pageSize: 0` / negative pins stay green.
- Other `pageSize` defaults (`kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts` 50, `marketplace/marketplace.zod.ts` 20) are different surfaces and ⛔ out of scope.
- The changeset names the behaviour change for authors who omit `pagination`: a view that declares no page size now shows 50 per page. Clause-②: the published default changes, so it is owed at tier.

## Unblocks
objectui#9853 (`Blocked-by:` this card). It lands its B structure reading the spec default once a spec carrying this change is installable in objectui: paged tables and lists show 50 per page, and non-paged views and kanban keep a renamed fetch batch of 100.
